activation_requires: global pause and publication budget enforcement
native image/video render and playback test
persisted media reservation state with concurrency control

seo_profile.title_limit_note: A practical editorial cap, not a universal Google ranking rule or guaranteed display width.
seo_profile.paragraph_style: short focused paragraphs; no repetition to increase length
seo_profile.keyword_style: natural context; no density quota, no city-name stuffing

media_policy.video_probability_note: Configurable proposed default; not a guaranteed quota.
media_policy.state_requirement: single writer lock + atomic durable state; ambiguous publications must be reconciled before retry
media_policy.video_rendering: controls; no autoplay; preload=none; responsive; validate native HTML preservation first
media_policy.media_link_budget: Image src/video src are media resources, not extra SEO anchors; any visible fallback link counts toward the 2..3 body link cap.
